slots.metaTitle: Anime Cabinet FAQ | Custom Anime Portraits
slots.description: Find answers about Anime Cabinet custom anime portraits, pricing, photo uploads, 24 styles, revisions, delivery times, and fan-art inspired commissions.
slots.bodySections: [{"heading":"How do custom anime and cartoon portrait commissions work?","paragraphs":["Our process is simple. Choose one of 24 anime and cartoon styles, upload your reference photo, and describe the character details you want. A human artist then hand-draws your original portrait using your photo and instructions as references. You receive a preview within 72 hours as standard, and unlimited free revisions are included so you can request adjustments before approval.","After you approve the artwork, we prepare the final digital file or selected print format for delivery. The result is a fan-art inspired interpretation of you, your family, friends, or pets—not an impersonation of a copyrighted character. You can explore options such as [Naruto](/portraits/naruto), [One Piece](/portraits/one-piece), [Dragon Ball Z](/portraits/dragon-ball-z), and [Ghibli Style](/portraits/ghibli-style)."]},{"heading":"Can an artist create an anime portrait from a photo?","paragraphs":["Yes. A clear photo is the best starting point for a custom anime portrait from photo. Your artist uses visible features such as hairstyle, expression, pose, clothing, and accessories to create a hand-drawn original character in your chosen visual style. You may upload more than one reference image when different photos show useful details.","For the strongest result, provide well-lit images with faces unobstructed and explain which person, pose, or feature matters most. A photo does not need to be professional, but blurry images or extreme angles may limit detail. You can also request a new outfit, themed background, props, or a specific mood."]},{"heading":"What information should I provide when ordering?","paragraphs":["Include your preferred style, the number of people or pets, reference photos, and any important details about clothing, pose, expression, background, colors, text, or accessories. Tell us whether the portrait is for a digital download, gift, or custom anime portrait canvas, and mention any deadline before placing your order.","If you want a custom anime portrait Naruto-inspired concept, for example, describe the ninja-themed visual direction, outfit, symbols, and setting you prefer. We create you as an original character in that style’s visual language rather than copying or presenting you as a copyrighted character. Clear instructions help your artist make the first preview more accurate."]},{"heading":"How much does a custom anime portrait commission cost?","paragraphs":["The price of a custom anime portrait depends on the format, number of subjects, style, and complexity of requested additions such as detailed backgrounds or props. Current options and pricing are shown during the ordering process, so you can review the total before submitting your commission. A custom anime portrait canvas may have a different price from a digital file because materials, size, and fulfillment are different.","If your idea includes several people, pets, or an elaborate scene, include those details when ordering so the correct option can be selected. When in doubt, provide your concept and our team can clarify what is included before the artist begins."]},{"heading":"How long does delivery take, and can I request changes?","paragraphs":["You receive the first preview within 72 hours under standard processing. Unlimited free revisions are included, allowing you to request reasonable changes to details such as colors, expressions, clothing, or backgrounds. Reviewing the preview promptly helps keep your commission moving toward final delivery.","If you have a firm event date, share it with your order details. Timing can vary with complexity and revision rounds, but our preview-first process gives you an early opportunity to guide the artwork."]},{"heading":"What styles and character requests are available?","paragraphs":["Anime Cabinet offers 24 anime and cartoon-inspired styles, including popular directions such as [Demon Slayer](/portraits/demon-slayer), [Jujutsu Kaisen](/portraits/jujutsu-kaisen), [Pokemon](/portraits/pokemon), and [My Hero Academia](/portraits/my-hero-academia). You can request a specific outfit, pose, color palette, background, or story-inspired theme, subject to the chosen commission option.","Our artists create fan-art inspired portraits featuring customers as original characters. We do not produce exact copyrighted-character impersonations, but we can capture the recognizable mood, visual language, and genre you love while keeping the finished portrait personal to you."]}]
